name: 0xnuller
description: 0xNullAI 平台 monorepo：六模块统一 Web 与 Android 应用、共享 Kit、Cloudflare 后端、MCP 与文档

scripts.build:kit: npm run build -w @dg-kit/core && npm run build -w @dg-kit/protocol -w @dg-kit/waveforms && npm run build -w @dg-kit/safety -w @dg-kit/tools -w @dg-kit/transport-webbluetooth -w @dg-kit/transport-tauri-blec
scripts.build:mcp: npm run build:kit && npm run build -w dg-mcp
scripts.build:product:web: npm run build:kit && npm run build -w @0xnullai/web
scripts.build: npm run build:kit && npm run build --workspaces --if-present --include-workspace-root=false
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:kit && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present --include-workspace-root=false
scripts.typecheck:product: npm run build:kit && node scripts/run-workspace-domain.mjs typecheck product
scripts.typecheck:mcp: npm run build:kit && node scripts/run-workspace-domain.mjs typecheck mcp
scripts.test:full: npm run build:kit && node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run
scripts.test:kit: npm run build:kit && node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --project=kit
scripts.test:mcp: npm run build:kit && node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --project=dg-mcp
scripts.test:product: npm run build:kit && node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --project=@dg-agent/web --project=android --project=auth --project=0xnullai-chat --project=control --project=market --project=playground --project=0xnullai-voice --project=web --project=agent-packages --project=platform --project=worker-proxies
scripts.android:init: npm run tauri -w @0xnullai/android -- android init --ci && npm run android:prepare
scripts.android:dev: npm run android:prepare && npm run android:dev -w @0xnullai/android
